<h1 class="greeting">Hi, I'm Hersh. I build and evaluate AI systems, and write about using them well in government.</h1>

:::::

::: {.bio}
I'm an applied scientist working on [responsible AI and generative AI evaluation]{.hl}. I've spent the past eight years building ML systems and leading data science teams, mostly across [government and enterprise]{.hl} settings. These days I'm focused on model evaluation, risk assessment, and figuring out how to deploy AI thoughtfully.
:::
